mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to elevated corporate earnings expectations and thus higher S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 20-day walk-forward, returns do not exceed +0.5% when demand increases, or negative when demand falls.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment, measured by PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In regimes of high unemployment, positive returns fail to materialize despite rising PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests supply-side constraints, prompting higher risk premia and negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: During periods of normal supply conditions, INDPRO expansion coincides with positive 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the 1-month UNRATE falls below 5%, central bank policy is interpreted as more accommodative, pushing up equity valuations and producing positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes, UNRATE increases do not correlate with positive 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising GDP demand, proxied by GDPC1, generate optimism about future earnings and drive a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: No significant return when GDPC1 growth reverses in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in job openings (PAYEMS) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, which amplifies equity risk appetite and yields positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In non-tightening labor markets, such dual signals do not produce outsized positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in FEDFUNDS above 4% triggers a sharp discounting of future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: No negative returns when FEDFUNDS spikes are followed by immediate rate cuts within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent weakness in industrial production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months indicates structural supply bottlenecks, which lowers expected growth and drives negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: During periods of balanced supply, INDPRO declines do not translate into negative 20-day forward returns.
